name: vscode-plantuml-renderer
description: Live preview for .puml and .iuml files using a local PlantUML JAR

plantumlRenderer.nativePath.description: Absolute path to a native PlantUML executable (no Java needed). When set, javaPath and jarPath are ignored

plantumlRenderer.jarPath.description: Absolute path to plantuml.jar (required unless nativePath is set)

plantumlRenderer.dotPath.description: Absolute path to the Graphviz dot executable

enumDescriptions: Graphviz dot (external process per render; PlantUML's reference layout)
Smetana, PlantUML's built-in port of dot (no Graphviz needed, faster redraws, layouts can differ)
plantumlRenderer.layoutEngine.description: Layout engine for class, component, state, use case and other graph diagrams

plantumlRenderer.idleShutdownMinutes.description: Stop the background PlantUML process after this many minutes without a render, to free its memory. The next render restarts it (about 0.6 s for the native binary, against about 0.05 s per warm render). 0 keeps it running

plantumlRenderer.includeRoots.description: Additional absolute directories allowed for local !include files

plantumlRenderer.fontFamilies.description: macOS with nativePath only: font families PlantUML loads at start-up, which cuts a cold start from about 0.45 s to under 0.03 s. The defaults back PlantUML's default and monospaced text. Other fonts a diagram names are added automatically if macOS lists them (one restart). Glyph fallback for CJK and emoji still works. Empty loads every installed font

scripts.build:fontallow: mkdir -p out && xcrun clang -dynamiclib -fobjc-arc -framework AppKit -arch arm64 -arch x86_64 -mmacosx-version-min=10.15 -o out/libfontallow.dylib src/fontallow.m
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build:prod && npm run build:fontallow
